title: PatternJ: an ImageJ toolset for the automated and quantitative analysis of regular spatial patterns found in sarcomeres, axons, somites, and more
authors: Blin MB; Loreau V; Schnorrer F; Mangeol P
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍ImageJ工具集PatternJ，用于分析肌节、轴突等规则空间图案的几何特征，属纯图像处理工具，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Regular spatial patterns are ubiquitous forms of organization in nature. In animals, regular patterns can be found from the cellular scale to the tissue scale, and from early stages of development to adulthood. To understand the formation of these patterns, how they form and mature, and how they are affected by perturbations, a precise quantitative description of the patterns is essential. However, accessible tools that offer in-depth analysis without the need for computational skills are lacking for biologists. Here we present PatternJ, a novel toolset to analyze regular pattern organizations precisely and automatically. This toolset, to be used with the popular imaging processing program ImageJ/Fiji, facilitates the extraction of key geometric features within and between pattern repeats. We validated PatternJ on simulated data and tested it on images of sarcomeres in insect muscles and cardiomyocytes, actin rings in neurons, and somites in zebrafish embryos obtained using confocal fluorescence microscopy, STORM, electron microscopy, and bright-field imaging. We show that the toolset delivers subpixel feature extraction reliably even with images of low signal-to-noise ratio. PatternJ’s straightforward use and functionalities make it valuable for various scientific fields requiring quantitative pattern analysis, including the sarcomere biology of muscles or the patterning of mammalian axons, speeding up discoveries with the bonus of high reproducibility.
abstract_zh: 规则空间图案是自然界中普遍存在的组织形式。在动物中，规则图案可从细胞尺度到组织尺度，从发育早期到成年期被发现。为了理解这些图案的形成、它们如何形成和成熟，以及它们如何受到扰动的影响，对图案进行精确的定量描述至关重要。然而，对于生物学家而言，缺乏无需计算技能即可提供深入分析的可访问工具。在此，我们介绍PatternJ，一种新颖的工具集，用于精确且自动地分析规则图案组织。该工具集与流行的图像处理程序ImageJ/Fiji配合使用，便于提取图案重复单元内及之间的关键几何特征。我们在模拟数据上验证了PatternJ，并在使用共聚焦荧光显微镜、STORM、电子显微镜和明场成像获得的昆虫肌肉和心肌细胞中的肌节、神经元中的肌动蛋白环以及斑马鱼胚胎中的体节图像上进行了测试。我们表明，即使在低信噪比图像中，该工具集也能可靠地实现亚像素特征提取。PatternJ的简便使用和功能使其对需要定量图案分析的各种科学领域具有价值，包括肌肉的肌节生物学或哺乳动物轴突的图案形成，以高可重复性的优势加速发现。
